audit.whatIsWrong: The page says Kassadin's Q silences (five places) and that his PASSIVE gives a magic-damage shield. Riot's text: Null Sphere damages and interrupts channels, and the shield comes from Null Sphere itself. Void Stone is flat magic damage reduction plus unit-collision ignore — no shield. It also claims his Q cancels your W 'mid-animation'.
audit.why: Rune Prison is an instant targeted cast, so a channel interrupt does not strip it; the real reason your rotation gets soaked is the Null Sphere shield on a 9s cooldown at rank 1 plus Void Stone's magic reduction. Nether Blade's auto reset (7s) is his burst tell and was never mentioned.
audit.corrected: Name Void Stone as magic reduction, put the shield on Null Sphere with its 9s rank-1 cooldown, drop the silence claim, cite Riftwalk 5s at rank 1 falling to 2s at rank 3, and flag the Nether Blade auto wind-up as the step-back cue.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nether Blade's auto-attack reset was absent everywhere.
audit.why: The wind-up, not the cast, is the tell for his damage step.

edits.before: Once Kassadin hits six his R lets him blink onto you or away from your root at will, and his Q silence arrives before your W can lock him in place. The window you owned at levels 2-5 closes almost immediately. Play for farm and poke from max range, using E to bounce Flux onto him from distance rather than walking up to chain W-Q — his R repositioning makes the melee-range pattern suicidal. His passive magic shield still costs you one Overload hit per engagement, so target it deliberately with your first E or Q so the empowered follow-up hits unprotected. Save R for macro pressure: a Realm Warp flank on another lane or objective fight is worth far more than a forced 1v1 you now lose.
edits.after: Once Kassadin hits six, Riftwalk blinks him onto you or out of Rune Prison on 5 seconds at rank 1 and only 2 at rank 3, and the window you owned at levels 2-5 shuts. Play for farm and poke at range, bouncing Spell Flux onto him from 615 rather than walking up to chain W-Q — that repositioning makes the melee pattern suicidal. Null Sphere hands him a magic shield every 9 seconds at rank 1, so spend a plain Overload into it and let the empowered follow-up land unprotected; the Nether Blade auto wind-up, not a cast, is his real burst tell. Save R for macro: a Realm Warp flank elsewhere is worth more than a 1v1 you now lose.

edits.before: At level 1 you both have only single-button kits — Kassadin's passive eats one of your Overload hits and his Q silence shuts down any attempt to root-chain, so do not all-in blind. Farm with Q at range and accept neutral. At level 2 the lane shifts: your W root comes online before his R, meaning he cannot blink away from a W-into-empowered-Q punish. Walk up, throw E to apply Flux, W him the instant he steps forward to Q you — the silence goes off after the root fires, and your empowered Q detonates Flux before he recovers. At level 3 the full E-Q-W cycling loop is running; Kassadin must stand in melee range with a champion whose only escape tool is still minutes away — force every trade your mana allows and build a lead before six.
edits.after: At level 1 you both have single-button kits — Void Stone cuts the magic damage of every Overload you land, so do not all-in blind. Farm with Q at range and accept neutral. At level 2 the lane shifts: Rune Prison is online long before Riftwalk, so he cannot blink out of a W-into-empowered-Q punish. Walk up, throw E to apply Spell Flux, then W him the instant he steps forward — with Flux on him that W roots instead of slowing, and Overload resets off both casts. Null Sphere interrupts channels, not instant casts, so nothing he owns stops the rotation once it starts. At level 3 the full loop runs and Kassadin has to stand inside your 615 range with no escape until six — force every trade your mana allows.

notes: Calibration-grade error corrected: the page credited Kassadin's PASSIVE with the magic-damage shield (it is Null Sphere) and called Null Sphere a silence in five places — Riot's text says it interrupts channels. Rune Prison is an instant targeted cast, so the old advice that his Q cancels your W mid-animation was doubly wrong. Nether Blade's 7s auto reset was missing entirely and is now the burst tell. Level chart already matched the packet and the mirror; no chart edits.
